scripts.dev: test -x .venv/bin/uvicorn || (curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && $HOME/.local/bin/uv sync --locked); test -f frontend/dist/index.html || (test -d frontend/node_modules || npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build); .venv/bin/uvicorn cubesat.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
